**Chinese name:** 紫光展锐（上海）科技有限公司 (Zǐguāng Zhǎnruì (Shànghǎi) Kējì Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Part of Tsinghua Unigroup (the same state-linked group behind YMTC), formed from the 2018 merger of Spreadtrum Communications (founded 2001) and RDA Microelectronics — one of the highest-volume mobile chipset vendors globally by unit shipments, concentrated in the mass market rather than flagship tier.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Mobile SoCs and baseband chipsets for entry-level and mid-range smartphones, plus IoT and automotive chip lines.
